title: "Video and Search: How Explainer Videos Help Pages Get Found" (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: How Explainer Videos Help Pages Get Found
slides.notes: A video won't rescue a weak page. But a good explainer, placed well and described properly, can help your page get found.

slides.title: Video makes a page more useful
slides.notes: Search engines want pages that answer the question. A clear explainer helps, and it can show up in video results and on YouTube. But it never guarantees a ranking boost.

slides.title: One topic per page, near the top
bullets: Product explainer on the product page
slides.notes: Put each explainer on the page whose topic it explains, and place it where people see it. A video buried at the bottom is easy to miss.

slides.title: Describe it in words search can read
bullets: Better: "How automatic invoice reminders work (2-minute explainer)"
slides.notes: Search engines read text, not pictures. Give the video a descriptive title, and tidy your speaker notes into a short transcript below it.

slides.title: Structured data, fast pages, captions
bullets: Embed, or load the player on click
slides.notes: Add video structured data, or check your platform does. Keep the page fast with sensible hosting, and use captions and a transcript together.

slides.title: Make the explainer from your deck
bullets: Start with your sales or product deck
Speaker notes become narration and transcript
On Pro, a.i. directs the video
slides.notes: Your sales deck already explains the topic. On Pro, a.i. directs the video, tightening the story and designing each scene. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
